The battle in Baltimore fell the way of the Springboks, and there were two key moments in the game that may have had both Springboks fans and All Blacks fans hiding behind their couches. Meanwhile, WXV got off to a cracking start and the best of the Pacific waged war in the Pacific Nations Cup semi-finals. Nigel Owens and Jamie Roberts analyse all the major incidents from the weekend that was!
Keep up-to-date on all things rugby by following World Rugby on social media
